name: Iterative Up-Down Tree Traversal
definition: A grid traversal algorithm for hierarchical octrees that avoids restarting the search from the root node when transitioning between cells. It uses the current node's position awareness to determine if the next cell is a sibling or child, and if not, it ascends the tree until an internal transition is found, then descends to the leaf.
summary: Iterative Up-Down Tree Traversal is an octree algorithm that minimizes traversal distance by ascending to find internal transitions and descending to leaves, avoiding costly root-to-leaf searches.
